questions.answer:
(1) that is
(2) who likes
(3) for her to take
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 빈칸 (1)~(3)에 들어갈 말을 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 완성하시오.

Mike: What a cool camera! Where did you get it?
Lisa: I won a photo contest last month. It's a prize of the contest.
Mike: Wow, I didn't know that you are good at taking pictures.
Lisa: I love it a lot. Taking pictures is fun.

<조건>
1. (1), (2)는 반드시 관계대명사를 포함할 것
2. (3)은 to, for를 반드시 포함할 것

(1) There is a camera _________________ a prize of the photo contest.
(2) Lisa is a girl _________________ taking pictures.
(3) Lisa said it was fun _________________ pictures.

subParts.answer: that is
acceptedAnswers: which is

subParts.answer: who likes
acceptedAnswers: that likes

subParts.answer: for her to take

questions.explanation: (1) 사물 선행사 a camera를 주격 관계대명사 that/which로 연결한다. (2) 사람 선행사 a girl은 who/that + likes로 연결한다. (3) <조건>에 따라 to와 for를 모두 포함해야 하므로 for her to take로 쓴다.

questions.answer:
(1) It is important for applicants to have an interest in interior design.
(2) It is better for candidates to have retail experience.
(3) It is necessary for employees to have communicative skills.
questions.question:
다음 구인 광고를 참고하여 요구 조건(requirements)을 각각 한 문장씩 완성하시오. (단, 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 활용하고 각각 9단어 이상으로 쓸 것)

JOB OPPORTUNITIES
Retail Sales - Part Time - Premium Home Furniture
GreenLeaf Living

GreenLeaf Living is a leading designer and maker of premium home furniture and décor. We're pleased to announce the opening of our newest branch in Central Plaza, Boston.

We are currently seeking part-time salesperson to join our sales division. If you have a strong sense of design and have working experience in customer service and retail sales, you should consider joining our sales team in Central Plaza.

Requirements:
(1) ______________________________________________________ (important, for, an interest in interior design)
(2) ______________________________________________________ (better, for, retail experience)
(3) ______________________________________________________ (necessary, for, communicative skills)

subParts.answer: It is important for applicants to have an interest in interior design.
acceptedAnswers: It is important for you to have an interest in interior design.
It is important for candidates to have an interest in interior design.

subParts.answer: It is better for candidates to have retail experience.
acceptedAnswers: It is better for applicants to have retail experience.
It is better for you to have retail experience.
It is better for candidates to have working experience in retail sales.

subParts.answer: It is necessary for employees to have communicative skills.
acceptedAnswers: It is necessary for you to have communicative skills.
It is necessary for applicants to have communicative skills.
It is necessary for candidates to have communicative skills.

questions.explanation: 「It is + 형용사 + for + 의미상 주어 + to부정사」 구문을 사용하여 각각 9단어 이상으로 요구 조건을 완성한다.

questions.answer: This is the park where Anna and Chris first met.
questions.question:
관계부사를 사용하여 다음 두 문장을 <보기>와 같이 한 문장으로 만드시오.
<보기>
• This is the station. • Emily met James at the station.
→ This is the station where Emily met James.

• This is the park. • Anna and Chris first met in the park.
(1) _____________________________________________________
questions.explanation: 장소를 나타내는 선행사 the park 뒤에 관계부사 where를 사용하여 두 문장을 연결한다.
acceptedAnswers: This is the park where Anna and Chris first met

questions.answer: where I can relax after work
questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 관계부사를 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
I want a cozy room in which I can relax after work.
→ I want a cozy room ______________________________
_____________________________________________________.
questions.explanation: 「in which」는 장소를 나타내는 관계부사 where로 바꿀 수 있다.

questions.answer: when Korea hosted the World Cup
questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 관계부사를 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
2002 was the memorable year in which Korea hosted the World Cup.
→ 2002 was the memorable year __________________
__________________________________________________.
questions.explanation: 시간을 나타내는 선행사 year 뒤의 「in which」는 관계부사 when으로 바꿀 수 있다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 관계부사를 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
Christmas is known as the day on which people give presents.
→ Christmas is known as the day ______________
____________________________________________________.
questions.explanation: 시간을 나타내는 선행사 day 뒤의 「on which」는 관계부사 when으로 바꿀 수 있다.

questions.answer: the city where the 2014 World Cup was held
questions.question:
다음 표의 내용과 예시를 참고하여 문장을 완성하시오.
<World Cup>
| Year | City |
| 2002 | Seoul, Korea |
| 2014 | Rio, Brazil |

<보기> Seoul is the city where the 2002 World Cup was held.

Rio is _____________________________________.
questions.explanation: 장소를 나타내는 선행사 city 뒤에 관계부사 where를 사용하여 완성한다.

questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 단어와 괄호 안의 표현을 이용해 글을 완성하시오.
<보기> when / why / where

Gyeongju is a place (1)_____________ (we, explore, can) the history of Korea. However, I couldn't understand the reason (2)________________ (so many tourists, visit) the city until I went there myself. I still remember the moment (3)_______________ (I, enter) Bulguksa Temple. The ancient buildings were so beautiful that I couldn't believe my eyes. I will never forget that day.

(1) (we, explore, can)
questions.explanation: 장소를 나타내는 선행사 a place 뒤에 관계부사 where를 쓰고, 조동사 can을 포함하여 where we can explore로 완성한다.

questions.answer: the year when the World Cup was held in Rio
questions.question:
다음 표의 내용과 예시를 참고하여 문장을 완성하시오.

| Year | City |
|------|------|
| 2002 | Seoul, Korea |
| 2014 | Rio, Brazil |

<보기> Seoul is the city where the 2002 World Cup was held.

2014 is __________.
questions.explanation: 시간을 나타내는 선행사 year 뒤에 관계부사 when을 사용하여 완성한다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 <보기>에서 골라 쓰시오.

[보기] how / when / why / where

June 6th is the day __________ I first saw her at the festival.
questions.explanation: 시간을 나타내는 선행사 the day 뒤에는 관계부사 when을 쓴다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 <보기>에서 골라 쓰시오.

[보기] how / when / why / where

I will explain the reason __________ I left the meeting early.
questions.explanation: 이유를 나타내는 선행사 the reason 뒤에는 관계부사 why를 쓴다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 <보기>에서 골라 쓰시오.

[보기] how / when / why / where

He reads books every day. That is __________ he has become a wise person.
questions.explanation: '그것이 ~한 이유이다'라는 의미의 관계부사 why가 알맞다. '그렇게 해서 ~가 되었다'로 보아 how를 써도 옳은 문장이 되므로 how도 정답으로 인정한다.
acceptedAnswers: how

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 <보기>에서 골라 쓰시오.

[보기] how / when / why / where

Emma will visit the park __________ she can walk with her dog.
questions.explanation: 장소(the park)를 선행사로 하며 그곳에서 일어나는 일을 나타내므로 관계부사 where가 알맞다.

questions.question:
다음 편지를 읽고 빈칸에 알맞은 관계부사를 쓰시오.

Dear Sarah,
I want to share some photos from our trip. Do you remember the park (1)__________ we spent our afternoon? This is the moment (2)__________ you saw a rainbow. Here's another photo of us. This is the café (3)__________ we had a wonderful lunch. I hope you keep these happy memories with you.
With Love,
Emily
questions.explanation: 장소(park, café)에는 where, 시간(the moment)에는 when이 알맞다.
acceptedAnswers: (1)where  (2)when  (3)where

questions.answer: 1. I need a peaceful room where I can relax in my free time. / 2. I will explain the reason why she was absent. / 3. Summer is the season when many people go swimming. / 4. That's the library where I am studying.
questions.question:
다음 표 (A), (B)에서 짝이 되는 문장을 하나씩 골라 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 네 문장을 쓰시오.

<조건>
1. (A), (B)에 주어진 문장은 한 번씩만 사용할 것
2. (A)+(B)의 조합이 되도록 할 것
3. 관계부사를 이용하되 생략하지 말 것
4. (A) 표에 제시된 문장 순서대로 (1)~(4)를 쓸 것

(A) 표:
- I need a peaceful room.
- I will explain the reason.
- Summer is the season.
- That's the library.

(B) 표:
- Many people go swimming in the season.
- I can relax in my free time there.
- She was absent for the reason.
- I am studying at the library.

subParts.answer: I need a peaceful room where I can relax in my free time.
I will explain the reason why she was absent.
Summer is the season when many people go swimming.
That's the library where I am studying.

questions.explanation: 장소에는 where, 시간(season)에는 when, 이유(reason)에는 why를 사용해 (A)와 (B)를 연결한다. 결합할 때 (B)문장의 중복 부사구(there, in the season, for the reason, at the library)는 삭제한다.

questions.answer: (1) where people enjoy relaxing  (2) when this famous building was completed  (3) where you can see the bright neon signs
questions.question:
다음 뉴욕(New York)을 여행하며 간략히 기록한 것을 활용하여, 아래 글을 완성하시오.

• Central Park: People enjoy relaxing here.
• The Empire State Building: This famous building was completed in 1931.
• Times Square: You can see the bright neon signs here.

I went to Central Park. It is a famous park (1)__________. Then I visited the Empire State Building. I heard that 1931 was the year (2)__________. After lunch, I went to Times Square. It is the only place (3)__________.
questions.explanation: 장소에는 where, 시간(the year)에는 when을 써서 각 문장을 완성한다.
acceptedAnswers: (1)where people enjoy relaxing  (2)when this famous building was completed  (3)where you can see the bright neon signs

questions.question:
다음 문장 (1), (2)에서 어법상 어색한 곳을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.

(1) January 1st is the day where I first saw her at the party.
(2) Emma will visit the park how she can walk with her dog.

(1) __________ → __________
(2) __________ → __________
questions.explanation: 시간(the day)에는 when, 장소(the park)에는 where가 알맞다.
acceptedAnswers: (1)where → when  (2)how → where

questions.answer: (1) place when → day when  (2) how → where
questions.question:
다음 글에서 어법상 어색한 두 군데를 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.

Tomorrow is Teacher's Day. Teacher's Day is the place when we show our gratitude to our teachers. I want to do something special for my teacher. I'm going to go to the store how I can buy a nice gift. I'll write a warm letter for my teacher.

(1) __________ → __________
(2) __________ → __________
questions.explanation: '날'을 나타내는 선행사는 day이며 시간에는 when을, 장소(the store)에는 where를 써야 한다.
acceptedAnswers: (1) place → day  (2) how → where
(1) the place when → the day when  (2) how → where

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 괄호 안에서 골라 차례대로 쓰시오.

[보기] can / you / where

Busan is the city __________ __________ __________ enjoy many wonderful beaches.
questions.explanation: 장소를 나타내는 관계부사 where 뒤에 주어(you)와 조동사(can)가 차례로 온다.

questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

(1) 이곳은 내가 그를 처음 만났던 곳이다. → This is the __________ __________ I first met him.

(2) 봄은 꽃이 피는 계절이다. → Spring is the __________ __________ flowers bloom.
questions.explanation: 장소에는 place where, 시간(계절)에는 season when을 쓴다.
acceptedAnswers: (1)place where  (2)season when

questions.question:
다음 각 문장의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 <조건>에 맞게 넣어 문장을 완성하시오.

<조건>
1. 반드시 w로 시작하는 단어를 쓸 것
2. 각각 한 단어씩만 넣을 것

(1) This is the garden at w__________ we used to sit.
(2) Saturday is the day w__________ we can sleep late.
(3) I don't understand the reason w__________ she cried.

subParts.answer: hich
acceptedAnswers: which
hich (which)

subParts.answer: hen
acceptedAnswers: when
hen (when)

subParts.answer: hy
acceptedAnswers: why
hy (why)

questions.explanation: (1)은 빈칸 앞에 전치사 at이 있으므로 관계부사 where를 쓸 수 없고 '전치사+관계대명사'인 at which가 된다. (2) 시간(day)에는 when, (3) 이유(reason)에는 why를 쓴다.

questions.question:
다음 문장과 같은 의미가 되도록 괄호 안의 우리말을 참고하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

Saturday is the day when she visits her grandparents.
(토요일은 그녀가 조부모님을 방문하는 날이다.)

→ Saturday is the day __________ __________ she visits her grandparents.

subParts.answer: on
which

questions.explanation: 시간을 나타내는 관계부사 when은 '전치사+관계대명사'인 on which로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. (that은 한 단어이므로 두 빈칸에는 on which)

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 우리말에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하시오.

그녀는 나의 아버지께서 자라신 마을에 산다.

→ She lives in the village __________ __________ __________ __________ __________ (where, raised).
questions.explanation: 장소(village)를 선행사로 하는 관계부사 where 뒤에 수동태 was raised가 온다.

questions.answer: A library is the place where you can borrow books.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 <보기>와 같이 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 바꿔 쓰시오.

<보기>
I was born on February 25, 1988. → February 25, 1988 is the day when I was born.

<조건>
1. 밑줄 친 부분을 주어로 할 것
2. 관계부사를 이용할 것

You can borrow books at <u>a library</u>. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 장소를 나타내는 선행사 'a library'를 주어로 하고, 관계부사 where를 사용하여 문장을 완성한다.
acceptedAnswers: A library is the place where you can borrow books

questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

넌 그녀가 어제 떠난 이유를 알고 있니?

→ Do you know the __________ __________ __________ __________ yesterday?
questions.explanation: 이유를 나타내는 선행사 reason 뒤에 관계부사 why를 쓴다. 'reason why she left'로 완성한다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계대명사를 이용하여 한 문장으로 만들 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

(1) That's the office. I work at the office. → That's the office __________ __________ I work.

(2) Tell me the reason. You are laughing for the reason. → Tell me the reason __________ __________ you are laughing.

subParts.answer: at which
for which

questions.explanation: (1) 장소 선행사 the office는 '전치사+관계대명사' at which로 연결한다(관계부사 where와 같은 뜻). (2) 이유 선행사 the reason은 for which로 연결한다(= why).

questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 같은 뜻이 되도록 알맞은 연결어를 <보기>에서 골라 문장을 완성하시오.

[보기] which / how / when / where / why / who / that

• This is the school. • The accident happened in the school. → This is the school __________. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 장소를 나타내는 선행사 'the school'을 수식하므로 관계부사 where를 쓴다. '전치사+관계대명사' 형태인 in which도 가능하다.
acceptedAnswers: in which the accident happened

questions.answer: where Amy lived for a month had a lovely garden just like a park
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 <보기>와 같이 관계부사를 이용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오.

<보기>
• I will tell you the reason. • He suddenly disappeared for the reason. → I will tell you the reason why he suddenly disappeared.

• The house had a lovely garden just like a park. • Amy lived there for a month. → The house __________. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 장소 선행사 the house를 관계부사 where절(where Amy lived for a month)로 수식하고, 나머지 부분(had a lovely garden just like a park)을 이어 쓴다. → The house where Amy lived for a month had a lovely garden just like a park.

questions.answer: (1) you remember the day when we first met  (2) where Sara studied was very cozy
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계부사를 이용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오.

• Do you remember the day? • We first met then.
(1) Do __________?

• The café was very cozy. • Sara studied at the café.
(2) The café __________. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

subParts.answer: you remember the day when we first met
acceptedAnswers: you remember the day when we first met?

subParts.answer: where Sara studied was very cozy

questions.explanation: (1) 시간 선행사 the day는 관계부사 when으로 연결한다. (2) 관계부사절이 선행사 바로 뒤에 오도록 The café where Sara studied was very cozy.로 결합하므로 빈칸에는 where Sara studied was very cozy가 들어간다.

questions.answer: (1) I don't understand the reason why she is upset with me  (2) Spring is the season when flowers bloom
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 관계부사를 이용하여 한 문장으로 만드시오.

• I don't understand the reason. • She is upset with me for the reason.
(1) __________

• Spring is the season. • Flowers bloom then.
(2) __________ ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.

subParts.answer: I don't understand the reason why she is upset with me
Spring is the season when flowers bloom

questions.explanation: (1) 이유 선행사 reason은 관계부사 why로 연결한다. (2) 시간 선행사 season은 관계부사 when으로 연결한다.
acceptedAnswers: (1)I don't understand the reason why she is upset with me  (2)Spring is the season when flowers bloom
